title: Rise Guest Lecture 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 99 attendees for this Guest Lecture, in line with turnout at our previous Guest Lecture events.
The requested budget of INR 12,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Guest Lecture.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
